sources.researchNote: The record gives Dobbri, Robert Renard and Frank Sandlers as references, and cites the Bibliothèque nationale de France catalogue of 19 March 2008, whose heading for Dobrindt then carried references from Saxon, Eddie (1886-1963), Harden, Eric, Elsberg, Friedrich, Grundhuber, Xaver and other names. The current BnF notice, ark:/12148/cb140036212, updated in June 2025, no longer lists Eddie Saxon among its associated identities.

media.title: Otto Dobrindt — printed portrait, about 1937
media.description: Otto Dobrindt in a printed portrait captioned with his name, dated about 1937 by the collectors’ forum that reproduces it. He directed the Odeon-Künstler-Orchester on the Kaper recordings sung by Hans Albers.
media.altText: Halftone portrait of the conductor Otto Dobrindt, captioned with his name.
media.publicCaption: Otto Dobrindt in a printed portrait captioned with his name, dated about 1937 by the collectors’ forum that reproduces it. He directed the Odeon-Künstler-Orchester on the Kaper recordings sung by Hans Albers.
media.publicCreditLine: Reproduced on grammophon-platten.de; photographer and place of publication unrecorded.
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared, and the provenance is thin: the halftone is reproduced on a collectors’ forum, which dates it to about 1937 but names neither photographer nor the publication it was printed in, so no term can be computed and the image is treated as protected. It is displayed at 228 × 323 px, the resolution published by the source, for scholarly identification of a documented conductor of Kaper recordings.
